item.title: Verbose beta 301
item.description:
Dictations you can find, and words that land

Also on iPhone

  • If a dictation's words don't land in the field, they're copied and the keyboard says so.
  • Your three newest dictations sit on Home under This week, each with a copy button.
  • The Recent dictations widget copies a dictation's words without opening Verbose.
  • Dictations has its own card at the top of Library, with your newest dictation.

Release notes on GitHub
